theorem.premise: Any sound refinement local to one clause preserves every genuine local lift and exports only the original three Boolean boundary bits after existential elimination.
theorem.result: Projected boundary relation is necessarily TRUE3 or OR3 because OR3 has codimension one as a subset of {0,1}^3.
theorem.consequence: Clause-local sound refinement either communicates nothing or reactivates the original clause; no intermediate boundary semantics exists.

keymaster_barrier.scope: ANY SOUND CUT LANGUAGE WHOSE CUTS ARE CLAUSE-LOCAL, WHOSE LOCAL AUXILIARIES ARE EXISTENTIALLY PROJECTED AWAY, AND WHOSE ONLY EXPORTED INTERFACE IS THE ORIGINAL THREE BOOLEAN BOUNDARY VARIABLES. CROSS-CLAUSE OR RICHER-INTERFACE CURRENCIES REMAIN OPEN.

next_gate.objective: Find a polynomially constructible nonlocal/rich-interface invariant that couples multiple clauses while retaining polynomial state, exact solve/reconstruction, and no selector-like search.
